spans.s: ādāna (IE 8-5; EI 12; CII 4), a levy or impost; same as ādāya.
ādatta (IE 8-5), adattā (EI 33), ādattā (EI 28), a tax of uncertain import; probably, interest or fine on arrears of tax.
ādāya (EI 33), income or impost; cf. bhūta-bhaviṣyad-vartamāna-niḥśeṣ-ādāya-sahita (IE 8-5); cf. also viseṇim-ādāya (EI 21), name of a tax.
